description: M9 LSM6DSO inherited IMU assumptions; AS5047P SPI on actual output after clutch; RLC2ICA10BB00A00 + MR026C ID12 wheel incremental output. Catalog INL/system errors are deterministic periodic terms, not quantization. Noise/bias/delay/filter assumptions remain conditional.

parts.joint: AS5047P output SPI 14 bit, after clutch
parts.wheel: RLC2ICA10BB00A00 through-hole 1024 interpolation, 0.5us edge separation, unique reference; MR026C ID12 36 poles; 36864 quadrature edge counts/rev
parts.error_basis: AS5047P displaced/full-temperature INL bound1.2deg modeled sin(2angle); RLS system error0.23deg modeled sin(angle), not measured harmonic shapes. Incremental wheel zero is relative; absolute startup crank outputs are known. Transport5ms is host assumption including device readout.
